note: The owner's preferences as checkable rules. 'hard' = never ship if violated; 'target' = measurable goals; 'style' = taste guidance a planner should follow; 'banned' = rejected by the owner. Source references point into STUDIO_SPEC.md and the edits in edits.json.

hard.rule: Faces centred (about 37% of frame height) and never cut off; >8% of a face outside the frame is a failure
Leave out shots whose face is wider than the 9:16 window
The edit loops seamlessly in picture and sound; audio built circularly; audio and video exactly the same length; no outro card
The last frames are built from frame 0's own image; blurred seam diff <= 1 (v11 standard)
The voidfx logo appears exactly once, as a transition (fly through the 'o'), never recoloured or restyled
No constant watermark, no outro card, no title card
No name tags, speaker chips, who-is-who graphics, counters, timecodes, or stamps on top of captions
Every word eases in (fade + rise + blur-to-sharp); nothing pops on
Text readable, inside the 1240-1640 px band, clear of faces and TikTok UI
Captions only on clearly sung or spoken words, each on its time, verified on the isolated vocal
Show a line as spoken only when his lips match; otherwise voice-over
Every transition has its own sound
No plain hard cuts in quiet or dialogue sections
-13 LUFS, true peak <= -2.5 dBTP after AAC
No audio clicks at any cut or the loop seam
No more than 3 flashes in any second
Visual sign-off on frames pulled from the encoded file before delivery
Report what was verified by frames and measurement; ask the owner to watch with sound
Lightning, seams, particles, streaks, suns and wipe edges are routed around a face/head box; particles in front of faces are masked

targets.rule: >= 24 designed transitions per ~24 s, none repeated except as a motif
No span longer than about 1 s without a cut, transition or designed beat
>= 3 multi-stage character-themed set pieces (drop, hook, loop) plus one focal set piece with layered sound
Beat-synced camera animation through every section with drums; every 'just moving' shot gets its own beat animation and sound

Speed ramps on every hook/montage shot (a burst on each beat, ~0.3-0.6x flow slow motion between, only where clean); beat camera with a ~5-6% zoom punch and ±1° rotation kick per beat, zoom blur and colour split on the hit frames, type clean on top; light that reacts to the footage
Window with sung lyrics; every clearly sung line captioned word by word; >= 3 picture moments land on sung words; explicit lyrics -> only a couple of designed titles
Graphics in every section, depth layers reacting to the person matte, physically lit
Restore 720p sources (sr_prep), check sharpness before and after, zoom <= ~1.1 on 720p, hero shots on high-bitrate packs
Measure every flash in the encode; a flare keeps the picture: peak mean luma about 110 or less (qcN.py 7b lists any above); and no white-out runs
The biggest transition lands on the song's biggest moment (full mix/bass return)
The loop is the most creative transition in the edit: a set piece that pays off the concept and lands in frame 0's own image, not a fade or white-out
Restyle library transitions before reuse; they carry their original edit's look (v6 cube grid, v9 jasmine)
When a burn/dissolve removes the subject, remove him before drawing scene light; fill with a plausible background, not a flat colour
'Add transitions, graphics and animations' = replace generic connectors with themed ones and add new cuts with new transitions, not stacked effects
Every lyric word on its sung onset, checked on the isolated vocal (pitch + onsets), not just Whisper (up to 1 s off)
A plain motion-blurred rewind loop reads as low quality; the loop is a set piece
Measure effect levels against the music at every set piece; on a loud master push effects about +9 dB and duck the music about 3 dB under the biggest hits

Sound the set pieces and structural hits only; no sound on every camera punch, letter, small transition or beat animation; no shimmer/chime 'shine' sounds; let the song carry the ending and the loop. A transition may be silent; mixcheck's buried list is a review list, not a target
targets.changes: 'every transition gets its own sound' (v6-v11) and v11 rule 8's 'each with its own sound'

targets.rule: Measure frame-to-frame activity of the encode per half-beat; any ~1 s+ span near the static floor (~1-1.5 grey levels vs 5-18 when active) gets a new cut and a designed transition
Every frame whose difference exceeds 3x the local median (+-6 frames) + 2 is a cut, a designed flash or a beat hit; anything else is a defect to fix
A custom graphic transition needs ~1 s on screen and a graphic >= ~8% of the frame width while it is read; move cuts to the next sung word to make room rather than squeezing

Flow on 24p held shots where it stays clean; procedural motion sub-pixel (no integer-step drift); tremble as smooth per-element sines, not per-frame random; no noise texture wraps inside the edit's time range (virtual frames included)
Cover transitions are exactly 0 at their ends and continuous across the cut; dissolve plates under the cover instead of switching

The loop dissolves into frame 0's picture under the cover, fades frame 0's finish in, renders frame 0's background animation at the wrap's virtual negative frames, and keeps periodic events off frame 0; seam <= 1 and no frame-diff spike across the wrap
Check the chosen source range for VFX colour flashes; they become pops under flow and transitions

style.concept: One sentence from the character's world or the song's own words, chosen before shots; carried through picture, grade, sound and loop
style.atmosphere_dexter: dark, tense, stylish, intense; kill room, plastic, blood slides, tools, the Code, Harry, the Dark Passenger, victims, season villains
style.atmosphere_flash: lightning, the Speed Force, the emblem, rivalries (Reverse-Flash)
style.transitions: pronounced, designed, physical, going THROUGH something from the character's world; motivated by something in the shot or lyric; pre-roll 6-15 frames, post-roll 8-18 frames
style.text: v9 standard: Inter Display Black caps, two-line keyline captions with red emphasis words, per-letter hero title with the edit's own exit particles
style.opening: compelling first 1-2 s; dialogue-led openings play as one continuous take
style.ending: deliberate; loops into the opening (same motif both ends)
style.dialogue: less is more: one or two short lines that set up the song
style.graphics: depth layers, themed overlays, halation, grain, anamorphic streaks; light sources behind the subject with a light wrap
style.props: blood, slides, knives, glass, tape allowed only when motivated, brief, physically lit or real footage, in the edit's look, off the face
style.own_look: each edit gets its own grade, type colour and transition mix; never reuse a benchmark's look (see style_bank)
style.sound: drone/room tone across the loop; layered transition sounds (whoosh + impact + material); riser and sub drop into the drop; tonal sounds in the song's key

banned: outro cards, title cards, constant watermarks
name labels, counters, timecodes, CJK subtitle lines
gimmick overlays on the face (target rings, converging strings)
text that pops on; v8-style thin wide-tracked sans / serif-italic / letter-by-letter fades
rapid single-word dialogue runs; exposition endings
slow-motion run-at-camera / floating shots that look odd
captions on words the song isn't singing
narration shown as spoken without matching lips
lingering or random props (parked blood slides, random drips, unmotivated knife pass); drawn-looking graphics next to footage
glowing-eyes gimmick shots (v10 rev 2: 'remove the scene with Barry's eyes being lit up')
glass webs over the frame or face (v10 rev 4, v103)
solving a moment with an overlay that sits on the frame (glass web, hanging shards); transform the picture itself (v10 rev 4)

style_bank_used.v106: WONDER: golden-hour amber against Speed Force cobalt, milky lifted blacks, red-orange halation (The Flash)

fresh_looks: red-and-black ink wash with Japanese-print restraint (no CJK)

process.one_brief: song, packs, theme ideas and must-haves in one message (repo/studio/START_PROMPT.md)
process.one_revision_per_feedback: apply every note in one pass, one full render + checkpoint
process.built_in_review: the studio catches problems itself and judges ship-readiness before sending
process.coalition: Two voidfx chats; this one is the Dexter studio (v106+). On every verdict write a handoff (sync/HANDOFF_TEMPLATE.md), update edits.json, preferences.json and sync/LEDGER.md, push, and send the file; adopt handoffs from the other chat the same way (sync/README.md).
